_comment: Full wiring example: ViewData approval task plus its success/failure branches, laid out per the vertical spacing convention (spine x=600, fork branches at spine ±264, y-delta 108px). Because a single task's transitions object cannot contain two entries with the same target key, Approve and Reject each route through their own newVariable task before converging on workflow_end.

e1f2.name: ViewData
e1f2.description: Prompts the operator to review and approve or reject before continuing

incoming.message: Please review the details below and approve or reject to continue.

a1a1.name: newVariable
a1a1.description: Sets approvalStatus to approved after operator clicks Approve

b1b1.name: newVariable
b1b1.description: Sets approvalStatus to rejected after operator clicks Reject

inputSchema_note: If 'body'/'message' content is dynamic, add 'dataToReview' (object) to the workflow's inputSchema, or produce it upstream via a task (e.g., makeData/merge/query) and wire $var.<taskId>.<out> into e1f2.variables.incoming.body instead of $var.job.dataToReview.
outputSchema_note: Add 'approvalStatus' (string, enum: approved/rejected) to the workflow's outputSchema so downstream consumers (or a parent childJob) can branch on the operator's decision.
